defs.def: a building or group of buildings where goods are made 工厂；制造厂

ex.s: My life as a tax-paying employed person began in middle school, when, for three whole days, I worked in a baking factory.
ex.t: 我作为一个纳税的上班族的生活始于中学时期，当时我在一家烘焙工厂工作了整整三天。

ex.s: be produced in factories in future
Smog comes from the words “smoke” and “fog”, and it is used to describe the air pollution in cities caused mainly by traffic and factories.
ex.t: 烟雾这个词来自"烟"和"雾"，用来描述主要由交通和工厂引起的城市空气污染。

ex.s: About 75 percent of the city’s factories and buildings, 90 percent of its homes, and all of its hospitals were gone.
ex.t: 该城市约75%的工厂和建筑、90%的住宅以及所有的医院都不复存在了。

ex.s: I work in a garment factory.
The factories, the great stores and newspaper buildings, the hotels, and the great houses of the rich are all gone.
ex.t: 那些工厂、大商店、报馆大楼、旅馆和富人的豪宅都已不复存在。

ex.s: South of Market Street, in the working-class neighbourhoods and in the factories, fires started.
ex.t: 在市场街以南，在工人阶层社区和工厂里，火情开始蔓延。
